regime_note: Initial launch parameters from research_uw_picker_v1. Pre-self-review baseline.

entry.min_filter_score_comment: 3 = exceptional-only: alert ONLY when >=3 of 4 UW conditions confirm (matches the research edge). 1 = any Tier A with >=1 UW condition (test/loose, do not use live).

exits.bot_auto_close_at_comment: Bot's default exit is TP1. T2/T3 noted in post for traders holding longer at own discretion.

uw_pulls.options_volume_days_back_comment: Only need ~15 days for z-score + OI evolution. 20 = small buffer. Override via CLI --vol-days for backtests on older dates.
uw_pulls.darkpool_days_back_comment: 10 trading days before entry day, used for cumulative block count + slope.

change_log.rationale: research_uw_picker_v1 baseline, no prospective data yet

1 was a test/loose setting left in by mistake; it alerted INTU on only 1/4 UW conditions (flow contradicting the thesis) and broadcast it to X with the full Bonferroni claim. 3 requires >=3 of 4 UW conditions to confirm, matching the research edge. Only exceptional, flow-confirmed setups now fire.
